title: NeoMundi Evidence Gateway - request envelope, version 1
description: What a caller submits. The gateway refuses anything this schema does not allow, before any engine is invoked; `additionalProperties: false` is deliberate and matches the discipline of the Evidence contracts.

schema.description: Exact contract identifier. A different value is refused rather than coerced.

operation.description: `verify` checks an Evidence archive. `attestation` checks a detached Ed25519/JWS attestation against an archive and a trust store.

request_id.description: Caller-supplied correlation identifier, echoed verbatim in the response. The gateway never generates one: an identifier it invented would not correlate with anything the caller holds.

path.description: Path to the artifact, resolved under the configured artifact root. A resolved path outside that root is refused (`path_outside_root`).

name.description: Logical name echoed in the response. It replaces nothing in the engine report; it is what the caller calls this artifact.

corpus.description: Directory of replayed inputs. Supplying it is what turns the engine's replayed-input digest control from NOT TESTED into a tested control.

attestation.description: Detached JWS file. Required for `operation: attestation`.

trust_store.description: Trust store file. Required for `operation: attestation`: without it the engine establishes no identity and can only answer NOT TESTED.

allow_test_keys.description: Accept a key whose declared status is `test`. A test key grants no attestation; this flag makes accepting one an explicit, recorded decision of the caller.

strict.description: Pass the engine's `--strict`. It changes no verdict line; it changes the exit code when a required guarantee is not demonstrated.

language.description: Language of the engine's control lines.
